name: Jugendzeltplatz Rettenau
beschreibung: The Jugendzeltplatz Rettenau (youth campsite) mentioned in the entry is said to be located in the municipality of Niederndorferberg in the Tyrolean Kaiserwinkl. However, no clear confirmation of a corresponding campsite at this location could be found through official sources. The Kaiserwinkl region comprises the municipalities of Kössen, Walchsee, Schwendt and Rettenschöss and is shaped by the Chiemgauer Alpen and the Kaisergebirge. It is a well-known hiking area with marked trails; in winter, the ski areas around Kössen and Walchsee are available. Niederndorferberg itself is an elevated settlement in the Kufstein district with a predominantly agricultural character. The entry describes a simple site with sanitary facilities, mainly for youth groups and budget-conscious travellers.
